metadata.title: Nintedanib with docetaxel, then eligible nintedanib continuation
metadata.indication: Adenocarcinoma NSCLC after first-line chemotherapy. Combination 21-day phase and eligible continuous nintedanib 28-day continuation are distinct.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

metadata.patient_scope: Choose current prescribed phase; no automatic switch after four or six cycles.
metadata.schedule_summary: Day 1: docetaxel drip, with no nintedanib. Days 2–21: nintedanib capsules twice daily. Repeat every 21 days for up to 6 cycles (about 18 weeks without delays); treatment may stop earlier. A later tablet-only phase needs a new team-confirmed plan.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or other appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00372 Version 6. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Current source tables reconciled in v0.84.30; independent review remains pending.

indications.description: Adults with locally advanced, metastatic stageIIIB/IV or locally recurrent adenocarcinoma NSCLC after first-line chemotherapy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Docetaxel 75 mg/m²IV Day 1 and nintedanib 200 mg twice daily Days 2–21 every 21 days up to 6 cycles. After≥4 combination cycles and consultant approval, nintedanib 200 mg twice daily continuously in 28-day cycles while beneficial/tolerated.

action.recommendation: Interrupt nintedanib. After AST/ALT recover to≤2.5×ULN AND bilirubin normal, consultant may reduce 200→150 mgBD, or 150→100 mgBD. Confirm current dose; no automatic restart.

rules.explanation: Interrupt nintedanib. After AST/ALT recover to≤2.5×ULN AND bilirubin normal, consultant may reduce 200→150 mgBD, or 150→100 mgBD. Confirm current dose; no automatic restart.

action.recommendation: AST/ALT>3×ULN with bilirubin≥2×ULN and ALP<2×ULN: permanently discontinue nintedanib when no alternative cause is established.

rules.explanation: AST/ALT>3×ULN with bilirubin≥2×ULN and ALP<2×ULN: permanently discontinue nintedanib when no alternative cause is established.

action.recommendation: Interrupt nintedanib and investigate the liver-injury pattern. Unless an alternative cause is established, permanent discontinuation is required; an unassessed cause is not permission to restart.

rules.explanation: Interrupt nintedanib and investigate the liver-injury pattern. Unless an alternative cause is established, permanent discontinuation is required; an unassessed cause is not permission to restart.

action.recommendation: NCCP Table 3 lists docetaxel 75 mg/m² for ALP>2.5×ULN with AST/ALT>1.5×ULN. This is already the regimen starting dose; do not label it a percentage reduction. Check severe hepatic patterns separately.

action.recommendation: Potential severe hepatic pattern: the NCCP Table 3 AND/OR layout is ambiguous (ALP>6, AST/ALT>3.5, bilirubin>ULN). The source says stop unless strictly indicated. Obtain consultant/pharmacy reconciliation with current docetaxel SmPC; no automatic dose or clearance is given.

rules.explanation: Potential severe hepatic pattern: the NCCP Table 3 AND/OR layout is ambiguous (ALP>6, AST/ALT>3.5, bilirubin>ULN). The source says stop unless strictly indicated. Obtain consultant/pharmacy reconciliation with current docetaxel SmPC; no automatic dose or clearance is given.

action.recommendation: Interrupt nintedanib until grade 1/baseline recovery, then consultant-directed 200→150 mgBD or 150→100 mgBD if a further reduction is needed. Verify current dose, symptoms and supportive care.

rules.explanation: Interrupt nintedanib until grade 1/baseline recovery, then consultant-directed 200→150 mgBD or 150→100 mgBD if a further reduction is needed. Verify current dose, symptoms and supportive care.

action.recommendation: Assess diarrhoea promptly, hydration/electrolytes and anti-diarrhoeal treatment; establish duration and response. Source interruption applies to≥grade 2>7 days or≥grade 3 despite treatment. Do not wait for these thresholds to seek care.

rules.explanation: Assess diarrhoea promptly, hydration/electrolytes and anti-diarrhoeal treatment; establish duration and response. Source interruption applies to≥grade 2>7 days or≥grade 3 despite treatment. Do not wait for these thresholds to seek care.

action.recommendation: Vomiting grade≥2 or nausea grade≥3 requires prompt antiemetic/hydration assessment. Confirm persistence despite supportive treatment; the combined source row is not converted into an automatic reduction when the supportive-treatment history is unknown.

action.recommendation: Source requires dexamethasone 8 mg orally twice daily for 3 days from the day before docetaxel and≥3 pre-treatment doses. If missed, only the consultant may consider 20 mgIV immediately before; do not automatically substitute or duplicate steroids.

action.recommendation: Monitor anticoagulant effect (e.g.INR) and clinical bleeding regularly; clinical context determines continuation.

rules.explanation: Monitor anticoagulant effect (e.g.INR) and clinical bleeding regularly; clinical context determines continuation.

rules.explanation: Discontinue nintedanib for ischaemic colitis. Exceptional reintroduction only after complete resolution and careful specialist review of risk.

action.recommendation: Grade 4 skin toxicity needs urgent specialist assessment. NCCP Table 5 names grade 3 skin reaction for 75→60 mg/m² and does not supply a separate grade 4 dose rule.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 skin toxicity needs urgent specialist assessment. NCCP Table 5 names grade 3 skin reaction for 75→60 mg/m² and does not supply a separate grade 4 dose rule.

action.recommendation: Severe docetaxel allergy requires immediate clinical management and no docetaxel rechallenge. Clarify whether docetaxel is still part of the current phase.

rules.explanation: Severe docetaxel allergy requires immediate clinical management and no docetaxel rechallenge. Clarify whether docetaxel is still part of the current phase.

eligibility: Adult adenocarcinoma NSCLC after first-line chemotherapy, ECOG0–1, life expectancy>3months.
At least4completed combination cycles before nintedanib-only continuation; up to6combination cycles.
exclusions: Nintedanib/peanut/soya/docetaxel/excipient hypersensitivity; more than1prior chemotherapy regimen for advanced/recurrent disease; severe liver impairment; baseline ANC<1.5×10⁹/L; pregnancy or breastfeeding.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile and BP.
FBC, renal/liver profile before each cycle; FBC also around nadir during combination and as clinically indicated after last combination cycle.
Liver tests each combination cycle and at least monthly during nintedanib-only continuation per SmPC; additional tests for risk or symptoms.
BP periodically/as clinically indicated; medication interactions, diarrhoea/hydration, bleeding, wound healing and thromboembolic symptoms.
Imaging / tumour-marker schedule follows individual disease monitoring plan.
dose_modifications: Source-specific nintedanib liver and toxicity interruption/recovery rules,200→150→100mg twice daily only after consultant review.
Docetaxel75→60mg/m² or discontinuation for source toxicities.
CrCl exactly30 and docetaxel hepatic AND/OR/ANC1.5 discrepancies remain explicit specialist-review boundaries.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Docetaxel infusion is low risk; oral nintedanib is minimal-to-low. Docetaxel steroid premedication must be reconciled with any antiemetic steroid.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk

treatment_phases.label: Combination phase
treatment_phases.duration_text: Up to six 21-day cycles; may stop earlier for progression or toxicity. At least 4 completed combination cycles required before NCCP continuation.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Docetaxel Day 1; nintedanib Days 2–21. Do not give nintedanib on the day of docetaxel.

administration.notes: 250 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 60 minutes; non-PVC bag. For doses>185 mg use 500 mL. Oral dexamethasone premedication and consider primaryG-CSF.
200 mg per dose twice daily approximately 12 hours apart, preferably with food. Maximum 400 mg/day. Do not take on docetaxel day. Swallow whole; no replacement for missed dose.

treatment_phases.label: Nintedanib-only continuation
treatment_phases.duration_text: Continuous twice-daily treatment in 28-day review cycles after≥4 completed combination cycles and consultant approval, while benefit persists and toxicity acceptable.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Nintedanib every day, including Day 1 of each 28-day cycle; no docetaxel. Not an automatic phase change.

administration.notes: 200 mg per dose twice daily about 12 hours apart continuously. Confirm the actual prescribed dose after any reductions; maximum 400 mg/day. No treatment-free week or docetaxel-day omission in this phase.
